about: Rules that read differently in Laravel (Blade, with Livewire or a script of the project). The lines replace the common ones.

no-double-submit.build: Disable the submit button while the request runs: wire:loading.attr in Livewire, or a state of the script the project uses; keep the server validation as the real guard.
no-double-submit.review: Submit twice quickly: the button is disabled after the first submit and the server rejects a repeated one.

examples.bad: <button type="submit">Save</button>  // stays active while the request runs

form-labels.build: Use a label for each input in the Blade component and show @error messages beside the field, tied with aria-describedby.
form-labels.review: Each input in a Blade form has a label; each @error message is tied to its input.

examples.good:
@error('email')

{{ $message }}

@enderror

errors-announced.build: Render validation messages with role="alert" next to the field and an error summary at the top of the form.
errors-announced.review: Submit an invalid form: each message is in an alert region and tied to its field.
